articles.title: ‘An honour’: Pochettino up for challenge of leading Manchester United revival
articles.summary: New head coach faces tough opening match at Anfield ‘It’s a big challenge but at the same time it’s adrenaline’ Mauricio Pochettino said it was “an honour” and “a privilege” to be the new Manchester United head coach after arriving in England on Wednesday. Pochettino flew from Cincinnati to Manchester overnight after overseeing the USA beating Haiti in his final game in charge. Members of Pochettino’s staff landed earlier in the week to begin work at Carrington , laying the foundations as United seek to turn their season around. His right-hand man, Jesús Pérez, the goalkeeping coach Toni Jiménez and the fitness coach Sebastiano Pochettino, who continues to work with his father, have already taken training with those not on international duty.
